page_title: GEN 0-1 JUV | Genoa v Juventus 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Daniele Chiffi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his powerful header from near the penalty spot crashes against the crossbar!
90+7' The referee signals a corner kick to Genoa.

90+6' That was a nice football moment. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. Michele Di Gregorio guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The linesman points to the corner flag, Genoa are going to take it.
90+3' Looks like Bremer (Juventus) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Kenan Yildiz leaves the pitch and is replaced by Weston McKennie (Juventus).
89' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
84' He should have scored! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
83' A substitution has been made. Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) goes off and Nicolas Gonzalez comes on.
82' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
80' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
78' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lorenzo Colombo.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) will replace Morten Frendrup.
77' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Mikael Egill Ellertsson will be replaced by Vitinha (Genoa).

73' 0 - 1 The ball was swung into the box by Filip Kostic from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus), who planted a long-range header inside the right post to make the score 0:1.
72' Filip Kostic (Juventus) steps up to send the ball in.
69' Flag up against Lloyd Kelly (Juventus). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
69' Juventus quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

68' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
67' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
65' Patrick Vieira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ruslan Malinovskyi replacing Valentin Carboni (Genoa).
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Nicolae Stanciu (Genoa) will be replaced by Morten Thorsby.
62' Igor Tudor prepares a substitution. Jonathan David (Juventus) is replaced by Dusan Vlahovic.
62' The substitution is prepared. Teun Koopmeiners joins the action as a substitute, replacing Manuel Locatelli (Juventus).
62' Igor Tudor has decided to make a change. Filip Kostic replaces Joao Mario (Juventus).
61' Nicolae Stanciu (Genoa) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Nicolae Stanciu (Genoa) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
57' Joao Mario (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
55' My Gran could have done better! Khephren Thuram (Juventus) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
52' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.

48' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+2' Nicolae Stanciu (Genoa) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' The foul by Valentin Carboni (Genoa) was seen by Daniele Chiffi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
43' Jonathan David (Juventus) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.

43' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Nicola Leali guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
41' Good clearance! Khephren Thuram (Juventus) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
41' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes it short.

41' A sweet pass finds Federico Gatti (Juventus) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Nicola Leali is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
40' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

40' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
38' The linesman raises his flag. Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is adjudged offside.
37' Joao Mario (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Juventus, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.

26' He should have scored! Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Michele Di Gregorio makes an easy save.
24' Valentin Carboni (Genoa) trips an opposition player and Daniele Chiffi signals a foul.
20' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes a short free kick.
19' Joao Mario (Juventus) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Chiffi had an easy-decision to make.
18' Joao Mario (Juventus) commits a foul and Daniele Chiffi immediately signals a free kick.
15' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Aaron Martin (Genoa) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
15' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Genoa have a free kick.
12' Aaron Martin (Genoa) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
11' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for an infringement. Genoa get a free kick.
11' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
8' Juventus enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Joao Mario (Juventus) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Juventus will kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi will officiate today.
